name: listSetAt
description: Replaces the contents of a list element.
syntax: listSetAt( string list, number position, string value, [string delimiters], [boolean includeEmptyFields] )

params.name: position
params.description: Position at which to set a value. The first list position is 1.

params.name: value
params.description: An element or a list of elements to set.

params.name: delimiters
params.description: Characters that separate list elements. The default value is comma.

params.name: includeEmptyFields
params.description: if set to true, empty values are included as well
